item.title: Aircraft Skids Off Runway at Delaware Coastal Airport
item.description: GEORGETOWN, Del. – The Georgetown Fire Company responded to an aircraft that went off the runway at Tuesday afternoon. At 2:15 p.m. on Feb. 17, crews arrived alongside Georgetown EMS and found an aircraft in a ditch. No injuries were reported with the incident.
